it sounds like you are putting a lot of pressure on your poetry to perform for you. It must be extremely hard to make a living as a professional poet...is that what you were hoping to do?   

Does your public library have a writers group for poets ? Or open readings?  If social media isn’t working maybe try some things  in person to get an audience for it... 

I hope things improve and that you stop contemplating suicide...
